verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs show it automates legal paperwork for equity actions (issuing stock, safes, stock options) which typically require board consents/resolutions, and it supports real-time collaboration, attorney review/comment, and audit logging of document changes (clerky-docs-9, clerky-docs-16, clerky-docs-13, clerky-docs-12, clerky-docs-4). However, the evidence never explicitly names 'board consent' or 'resolution' as a document type or describes an e-signature/approval-collection workflow for board members specifically. Missing for 10: explicit board consent/resolution templates, dedicated approval/signature collection flow for board members, and independent confirmation of this specific use case.
